style: Palette of deep indigo night, violet haze and rose-magenta light, with pale teal highlights.

images.name: hero
images.prompt: Ultra-wide establishing view from deep space of a fully developed star system at peace: a bright star partly wrapped in a delicate lattice of thousands of glittering solar collector panels, an Earth-like planet in the foreground encircled by luminous orbital rings and thin space elevators, ring-shaped colony stations and giant cylinder habitats hanging in space, orderly streams of tiny ship lights flowing along invisible lanes between the worlds, a calm, prosperous, monumental civilization

images.name: eradication-wars
images.prompt: Wide battlefield view on a burning colony world under a red sky: towering humanoid war mechs striding through ruined prefab city blocks, enormous warships trading beams of light in low orbit overhead, a cracked energy shield dome flickering above the city, columns of smoke and distant explosions, tiny infantry silhouettes for scale, desperate apocalyptic total war with nobody holding back

images.name: milky-way-war
images.prompt: Vast space battle at the edge of a glowing nebula: a disciplined fleet of sleek white and silver warships in formation firing streams of light into an enormous swarm of organic space monsters, writhing hive creatures with chitin plates, glowing maws and long tendrils, some as large as moons, reaching toward a colonized planet with city lights behind the fleet, epic scale

images.name: expedition
images.prompt: A lone small dark stealth starship drifting through the black emptiness between galaxies, approaching a colossal ruined alien megastructure, broken rings and spires the size of continents with faintly glowing geometric seams, debris floating around it, distant spiral galaxies hanging in the void, a sense of discovery, loneliness and danger

images.name: wilderness
images.prompt: The edge of the universe seen from inside: a gigantic curved wall of swirling cosmic storms rising like the inner slope of an enormous bowl, galaxies, stars and debris being swept up the curve and tumbling back down, veins of lightning-like energy across the storm wall, a tiny research starship in the foreground observing it, awe-inspiring and strange

images.name: civilization
images.prompt: Street-level wide view of a sunny walkable city plaza of the far future: clean modular prefab buildings with bold colour-coded stripes of sky blue, white, gold and green, a sleek tram gliding on ground rails, people on bicycles, scooters and skateboards, a joyful mixed crowd of beautiful bioengineered people with unusual hair and skin colours, a few with animal ears, tails or feathered wings, slender humanoid robots and friendly aliens in sleek environment suits mingling among them, a green park beside the plaza, warm optimistic daylight

images.name: chaos-rift
images.prompt: A colossal wound torn in space engulfing two star systems: a jagged spreading tear of violent violet and crimson energy erupting from a shattered planet, a gigantic broken satellite cannon drifting in the foreground, storms of glowing cosmic mist swallowing space stations and moons, streams of evacuation ships fleeing as points of light, eerie and catastrophic

images.name: monsters
images.prompt: An endless roaming horde of monstrous things crossing the darkness between galaxies toward a distant spiral galaxy: biomechanical leviathans, swarms of spiky self-replicating war machines, clouds of grey metallic particles, and enormous asteroids overgrown with pulsing flesh, all lit by a sickly glow from below, overwhelming numbers, dread

images.name: ftl-launch
images.prompt: At the dark outer edge of a star system, a sleek white starship launching into faster-than-light flight from a colossal ring-shaped launch gate, a giant coil tower beside the gate latching onto the ship with a bright plasma tether beam, the ship's frontal shield flaring into a brilliant pointed cone of plasma ahead of it, a shimmering rainbow energy field wrapping the hull, engine wake blazing, the distant star small behind it

images.name: planetship
images.prompt: A whole Earth-like planet travelling through deep space like a spaceship: six colossal thrusters built into its surface blazing long blue-white plumes, the planet enclosed in a thin translucent protective shell held up by glowing orbital rings, city lights across its night side, escort fleets of tiny ships around it, a distant nebula behind
